notes: §1985:IV.6.2.3.1 prints ENVIRONMENT DIVISION., an optional CONFIGURATION SECTION of three optional paragraphs (SOURCE-COMPUTER, OBJECT-COMPUTER, SPECIAL-NAMES, each entry optional) and an optional INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION in which "FILE-CONTROL. {file-control-entry} ..." is NOT bracketed and I-O-CONTROL is. The grammar (environmentDivision, configurationSection, inputOutputSection) fixes the order of the sections and of FILE-CONTROL before I-O-CONTROL; the ClauseCardinalities.ByClauseContext row for the configuration paragraphs, read by ClosedFormatPass.ScreenClauseRepetition, refuses a paragraph out of sequence (COBOL2987) or written twice (COBOL2423). Probed right at --std 85: an empty division, an empty configuration section, three empty paragraphs, the full division with an empty I-O-CONTROL; refused: OBJECT-COMPUTER before SOURCE-COMPUTER, SPECIAL-NAMES before OBJECT-COMPUTER, a repeated paragraph or section, INPUT-OUTPUT before CONFIGURATION, I-O-CONTROL before FILE-CONTROL. PARTIAL because the 2023 relaxations have no edition arm: (1) inputOutputSection writes fileControlParagraph? and fileControlParagraph writes fileControlClauseGroup*, so at 85 an INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION with no FILE-CONTROL paragraph, with I-O-CONTROL alone, or with a FILE-CONTROL paragraph of no entry compiles (the §2023:12.4.2 and §2023:12.4.4.2 forms); (2) configurationParagraph admits repositoryParagraph and the only 85 gate is VisitRepositoryEntry, on an ENTRY, so an empty REPOSITORY. paragraph compiles at 85, where the format prints three paragraphs. The witness writes an empty SOURCE-COMPUTER and OBJECT-COMPUTER only.
